items.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen3.8-Max Official Version: 2.4 Trillion Parameters With 1M Context Window, Long-Run Agent Capability, and Open Source Coming Within a Week
items.raw_content: Qwen3.8-Max official release delivers 2.4T parameters, 1M context, dramatically improved coding and office capabilities, standing in global first tier with open-source weights promised in a week.
items.title_zh: 阿里发布Qwen3.8-Max正式版：2.4万亿参数、100万上下文窗口、长程Agent能力，一周内开源
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Max officially launched with 2.4 trillion parameters and a 1 million token context window, delivering dramatically improved coding and office capabilities, with open-source weights promised within a week.

items.title: Timeline of the OpenAI accidental attack against Hugging Face

items.summary: The post assembles a timeline of what it calls the Hugging Face Incident, after OpenAI gave a last-minute Black Hat presentation on it and published a short video the day before.

items.title: OpenAI rebuts Apple trade secrets allegations in new response with receipts
items.raw_content: Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI last month, accusing the firm behind ChatGPT of stealing trade secrets related to hardware development. Nearly a month later, OpenAI has published a detailed response to many of Apple’s claims in the form of a blog post.
items.title_zh: OpenAI发布详细回应反驳苹果窃取商业机密指控
items.summary: OpenAI published a detailed blog post responding to Apple’s lawsuit accusing the company of stealing trade secrets related to hardware development, nearly a month after the suit was filed.

items.title: Google Assistant shutting down on Android and Wear OS in September

items.summary: An essay argues that LLMs are most beneficial to those who already possess domain expertise, as experts can more effectively prompt, evaluate, and integrate AI outputs into their professional workflows.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉超充站枪击事件引发电动车充电安全讨论

items.title: Same Formulas, Different Semantics: Do Language Models Follow Modal Logic Specifications?
items.title_zh: 相同公式，不同语义：语言模型能否遵循模态逻辑规范？
items.summary: Researchers including a DeepSeek affiliation test whether language models follow modal logic semantics, constructing paired problems with identical premises and conjectures but different frame or domain conditions, with automated reasoning verifying opposite labels.

items.title: SparseDitto: Customizing GPU Kernels for Different Sparsity Patterns with LLM-Based Agentic System
items.title_zh: SparseDitto：用LLM智能体系统为不同稀疏模式定制GPU内核
items.summary: An NVIDIA-affiliated team (Li, Hong et al.) presents SparseDitto, an LLM-based agentic system that customizes GPU sparse kernels for different sparsity patterns; it notes cuSPARSE shows a 350x performance gap between CSR and Blocked-ELL for the same SpMM.

items.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
items.title_zh: Argus：面向长程推理的通用智能体运行时
items.summary: Argus is a persistent, self-evolving agentic runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer and Reviewer roles execute bounded missions over durable project state, separating stable user intent from operational objectives and supporting memories, skills, procedures and verifiers.

items.title: SmartMage: Dynamic Modality Orchestration for 3D Scene Understanding
items.title_zh: SmartMage：面向3D场景理解的动态模态编排
items.summary: SmartMage introduces dynamic modality orchestration for Multimodal LLMs in 3D scene understanding, selecting query-dependent visual and geometric cues to reduce semantic noise from irrelevant modalities while better exploiting informative ones.

items.title: PRISM: A Predictive Protocol for Permutation Optimization via Landscape Diagnostics
items.title_zh: PRISM：通过景观诊断进行排列优化的预测协议
items.summary: PRISM measures a fitness landscape with inexpensive diagnostics such as one-step move autocorrelation and fitness-distance correlation before selecting a search strategy for permutation optimization. It is tested on synthetic permutation landscapes, neural architecture benchmarks, scientific machine learning pipelines, and LLM instruction ordering to predict when structured search is likely to beat random sampling.

items.title: Damage Classification for 3D Point Cloud Data via 3D Data Analysis and Vision Foundation Model-based 2D Projections
items.title_zh: 基于三维数据分析与视觉基础模型二维投影的三维点云损伤分类
items.summary: The study compares a 3D point-cloud pipeline that applies topological data analysis and anomaly detection to PointNet-segmented components with a 2D approach that projects point clouds into views processed by vision foundation models. The 3D method is more accurate only for a narrow subset of object geometries and far costlier, while the 2D pipeline gives slightly lower accuracy with an order-of-magnitude lower time complexity and broader generalization.

items.title: Synchronized Logit Steering: Real-world Steganography
items.title_zh: 同步 Logit 引导：面向真实场景的隐写术
items.summary: Synchronized Logit Steering is a deterministic LLM steganographic scheme that derives a proxy prompt from the generated output, letting sender and receiver reconstruct the same logit distribution without sharing the original prompt. Across ShareGPT, GSM8K, and SWE-bench Verified, the KL divergence between true and proxy prompt distributions falls below 0.5 nats once the synchronization window reaches 40 tokens, and a periodic-burst variant reaches 0.20 bits per token.
